tasks.name: Energy code compliance docs (Manual J/D/S, HERS)
Septic system design & permit (if not on sewer)
Well permit / water source approval (if not on public water)
Order long-lead items (trusses, windows, custom cabinets, garage doors)
Site mobilization (temp power, toilet, dumpster, signage)
Foundation walls / stem walls (form & pour, or block)
Wall construction (sill plate, floor framing, subfloor, wall framing & sheathing)
Framing punchout (inspection, house wrap, windows & exterior doors)
HVAC rough-in (ductwork, line sets, equipment set)
Plumbing fixture trim-out (sinks, toilets, faucets, tub/shower)
Final hardscape (patios, walkways not done earlier)

subs.scopeOfWork: Owner-side responsibility. Covers securing the building lot through purchase or existing ownership, and confirming the site is ready to begin due diligence (soil testing, survey, design).

Perform soil and percolation testing on the lot to confirm suitability for the planned foundation type and septic system, and provide a written report/certification for the architect, engineer, and permitting agencies.
Provide a boundary and topographic survey of the property, and later stake out the foundation layout on site so excavation and footings can be placed accurately per the approved plans.

Produce full architectural design and construction drawings (floor plans, elevations, sections, and details) sufficient for permitting, engineering, and construction, and be available to answer design questions through permitting and framing.
Provide structural engineering calculations and stamped drawings (foundation, framing, load paths) as required by the building department, coordinating with the architect on any design revisions.
Prepare energy code compliance documentation (Manual J/D/S load calculations, HERS rating documentation) required for permitting and to guide HVAC and insulation design.
Prepare and submit the building permit application package and manage the review/approval process with the local building department through to permit issuance.

Overall project management: zoning approval, subcontractor bidding and selection, ordering long-lead materials, mobilizing the site, and leading the final punch list, corrections, and owner walkthrough through project closeout.
Design and permit the septic system (where the site is not on public sewer), then install the septic system once foundation excavation is complete and the permit is in hand.
Secure well permit/water source approval (where not on public water) and drill and complete the well once the site is graded and access is available.
Underwrite and close the construction loan/financing so that funds are available to mobilize the site and pay subcontractors per the draw schedule.
Bind builder's risk and general liability insurance coverage for the project prior to site mobilization and keep coverage active through completion.

Site earthwork package: install erosion control/silt fencing, clear the lot, rough grade, build temporary construction access, excavate for the foundation and footings, and later install foundation drainage and backfill.
Trench and rough in water, sewer, and electrical service lines from the utility source to the house after rough grading is complete.
Form and pour all concrete flatwork and structural concrete: footings, foundation/stem walls, waterproofing, slab prep and pour, and later the driveway and walkway concrete.
Perform all required municipal inspections at each construction milestone (footing, foundation, framing, rough-in, insulation, and final) and sign off before work proceeds to the next phase.
Apply termite pre-treatment to the soil/foundation area prior to slab pour per code and manufacturer requirements.
Complete all plumbing scopes: under-slab rough-in, above-grade rough-in (supply/DWV, tub and shower sets), and final fixture trim-out (sinks, toilets, faucets).

Frame the structure from the ground up: sill plate, floor system, subfloor, exterior and interior wall framing, sheathing, roof framing/truss set, roof sheathing, house wrap, and setting windows and exterior doors to achieve dry-in.
Install roof underlayment, the finished roofing material (shingle/metal/tile per spec), and all flashing, vents, and penetration details to make the roof watertight.
Furnish and install gutters and downspouts, both the rough set during construction and the final tie-in near project completion.
Complete all electrical work: rough-in wiring and panel set, final device/switch/fixture trim-out, and exterior lighting finalization.
Install the HVAC system: rough-in ductwork, refrigerant line sets and equipment set, followed by trim-out of registers/grilles/thermostat and system startup/commissioning.
Rough in and later install low-voltage systems including data/network wiring, security, and audio/video equipment.
Rough in the fireplace/chimney system per manufacturer specifications and code requirements.
Complete the exterior weather envelope: flashing and sealant details, siding installation, exterior trim, and soffit/fascia.
Install wall, floor, and attic insulation (batt, blown, or spray foam per spec) and perform air sealing prior to insulation inspection.
Hang, tape, mud (multiple coats), texture, and sand/prime all interior drywall to a paint-ready finish.
Install exterior masonry and stone veneer per the architectural elevations after siding is underway.
Paint or stain all exterior surfaces after trim/siding/masonry are complete, and paint all interior walls, ceilings, and trim prior to flooring and finish carpentry.
Furnish and install the garage door(s) and opener(s) once siding is underway.
Install tile work in bathrooms and kitchen backsplash areas per finish selections after drywall finishing is complete.
Install interior finish carpentry: door and window casing, baseboard, interior door hanging, and stair rails/balusters.
Furnish and install all kitchen and bathroom cabinetry per the approved design and finish selections.
Template countertops after cabinet installation, then fabricate and install finished countertops.
Furnish and install finish flooring (hardwood, tile, LVP, or carpet per selections) after interior trim is complete.
Deliver and install kitchen and laundry appliances after plumbing fixture trim-out is complete.
Final grade the site, install landscaping/sod/planting, and complete final hardscape (patios, walkways) not addressed earlier in construction.
Perform final construction cleaning of the entire house after all trades have finished their trim-out and finish work, preparing it for the punch list walkthrough.
Municipal authority responsible for final inspections sign-off and issuance of the Certificate of Occupancy.
Handle closing paperwork and disbursement for the final sale/transfer of the completed home to the owner/buyer.
